data.title: Speeding fine of €98.50 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Central Fines Office (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland) issued a fine notice dated 16 September 2025 for driving 23 km/h over the limit on the A 49 on 27 August 2025. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving-fitness register. It was formally delivered on 19 September 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding (93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone). The fine is €70.00 plus €25.00 fee and €3.50 costs, and you get 1 point. You may object (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office; the app shows the deadline. The letter was formally delivered, so the period counts from the delivery date. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final and can be enforced. Then you must pay within two weeks of it becoming final, using the file number as payment reference. If unsure whether to object, consider getting legal advice.
